thread:
Eli Torres: dropped a new prototype for the setup wizard 1 — introducing a compact 'summary strip' for network readiness at the top of the networking step. figma: https://figma.com/file/abc

Priya Nair: i like the strip. it's less intimidating than an expanded probe panel. quick thought: it should show a short reason when degraded, e.g. `Degraded 30% packet loss to egress` instead of just 'Degraded'.

Jonah Kim: +1 on concise reason. also let's show a tiny action: `Retry probe` and `View details` so folks can act without leaving the current step. keep actions single word.

Lin Gomez: accessibility notes: the strip must be a live region (aria-live="polite") so screen readers announce status changes. also include sr-only readable text like `Network readiness: Healthy, last checked 1 minute ago` to avoid color reliance.

Eli Torres: good call on aria-live. Priya, can you provide 2-3 short status reason examples for copy? degraded, blocked by firewall, dns misconfigured, auth failure.

Priya Nair: sure: "Blocked by firewall rules", "DNS resolution failed for storage.redwood.ai", "Authorization to registry denied", "High packet loss to region-us-west". each should fit a single-line truncated view.

Jonah Kim: UI behavior: truncate reason after ~40 chars with ellipsis; on hover, show full tooltip. `View details` opens a modal with probe logs and suggested fixes. modal should have `Copy diagnostics` button.

Lin Gomez: keyboard behavior: strip should be tabbable and support Enter to open details modal. when status changes, focus shouldn't jump; instead screen reader announcement + subtle visual pulse. add `role=status` on the strip container.

infra-bot: automated check complete  summary: Healthy  last_check: 2025-11-09T15:02:34Z

Eli Torres: thinking about handoff for non-network engineers: change primary label from 'Network readiness' to 'Connectivity summary' and put `for advanced users` hint on the details button. which version do we prefer for the strip label?

Priya Nair: prefer `Connectivity summary`  sounds less scary for product folks.

Jonah Kim: agree. also microcopy variants for the strip header please: (A) Connectivity summary, (B) Connectivity summary  checks for on-prem hosts, (C) Network status  with tooltip explaining probe cadence. we should test (A) vs (B) in a quick hallway study.

Lin Gomez: i'll draft the sr-only wording and the aria attributes: `aria-live=\"polite\" role=\"status\" aria-atomic=\"true\" aria-label=\"Connectivity summary: Healthy; last checked 1 minute ago\"`. include instructions for screen reader users for opening details: `Press Enter to view probe logs` inside the sr-only text.

Eli Torres: UX small ask: when multiple hosts are in the step, the strip should show the worst status (red > amber > green) and a badge `3 hosts` that expands into a small flyout list. flyout must be navigable with arrow keys.

Jonah Kim: implementation: maintain cached per-host probe + aggregate. hitting `Retry probe` triggers parallel cheap checks and updates strip. show a spinner on the Retry button and debounce repeated clicks.

Priya Nair: error copy for failed retry: `Retry failed  We couldn't reach the host. Check firewall/egress rules or try again.` short, actionable. include a link `Learn more` to the troubleshooting KB.

Lin Gomez: accessibility for the flyout: use role=\"listbox\" and role=\"option\" for hosts, add `aria-selected` on focus. ensure ESC closes flyout and returns focus to the strip button.

Eli Torres: final deliverables for this pass: 1) three header copy variants, 2) truncated reason examples (Priya did), 3) aria spec from Lin, 4) hover/keyboard behavior notes, 5) a small API contract for Retry and Diagnostics button (Jonah). i'll compile and push updated figma by EOD.
